# Important Notice for the ChromaMatter 0.9 Demo Data

[日本語](NOTICE_JA.md)

## Distribution status and rights

The distributor includes only the following two evaluation payloads after
confirming their publication and distribution rights:

- `Original AI model Color.glb` was generated under a paid Hi3D plan and is
  cleared for publication and distribution in this package.
- `Reference.jpg` is original material that the distributor may publish and
  distribute; it is not a repost of a third party's work.

**Generated by Hi3D**

No generated, derived, or sample 3MF is included. The exact public paths,
sizes, and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in
[DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json](DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json). Any `.3mf`, generated
project, validation sidecar, or unlisted payload must be excluded from the
public DemoData package.

The demo files are separate materials from the `GPL-3.0-or-later`
ChromaMatter software. ChromaMatter's `LICENSE.txt` does not apply to them.
Inclusion in this package does not automatically grant recipients a right to
redistribute, sell, repurpose, use as training data, or otherwise exploit the
demo files separately. Unless applicable law permits it or the rights holder
grants separate permission, use them only to evaluate ChromaMatter.

## Preserving provenance

`Reference.jpg` contains C2PA Content Credentials describing Google Generative
AI and SynthID provenance. The distributed file preserves that information.
Re-saving the image, stripping metadata, or converting it may prevent
provenance verification and will change the recorded SHA-256.

## Independence and compatibility

ChromaMatter is an independent project. It is not an official, affiliated, or
endorsed product of Hi3D, Google, Snapmaker, or any other third party. Product
and service names are used only to describe compatibility, provenance, and the
workflow.

**Important 0.9 limitation:** Hi3D-style multipart GLB support and
solidification are beta, unofficial, and input-dependent. The source GLB's node
names do not reliably match the visible body regions. Successful import does
not prove that solidification, 3MF export, slicing, or printing will succeed.
The single-model repair improvements do not resolve every multipart case.
Inspect every generated project in Snapmaker Orca before printing.

## Integrity verification

Expected sizes and SHA-256 values for the two DemoData payloads are recorded in
[DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json](DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json). Use the package-level
`SOFTWARE_PACKAGE_SHA256.txt` as well when verifying the complete package.
